title:
Ocean Pulse — 3rd Place, ML/AI Track
    @ DataHacks 2026
description:
An award-winning machine learning project
    developed by a team of four to classify
    California Current marine ecosystem health.
background:
Using historical CalCOFI oceanographic data
    from 1949–2021, we explored how environmental
    conditions influence marine ecosystem health.
methods:
Trained a Random Forest classifier using
      286,819 oceanographic samples.

Classified ecosystem health into three
      states: Healthy, Stressed, and Critical.

Analyzed feature importance to identify
      key environmental predictors.
takeaways:
Identified phosphate and nitrate as
      the top two predictors of ecosystem health.

Built an interactive Streamlit dashboard
      featuring predictions, trends, and
      environmental data visualizations.

Won 3rd Place in the ML/AI Track
      at UCSD DataHacks 2026.
tools:
Python, scikit-learn, Random Forest,
    Streamlit, Data Visualization

title: California Real Estate Market Analysis
description:
An analysis of California residential real estate
          data, exploring property features, pricing
          patterns, and house price prediction.
background:
Housing prices vary widely across California.
          This project explores how location and property
          characteristics relate to those differences.
methods:
Explored price distributions and relationships
            between features.

Used one-hot encoding and feature scaling
            to prepare model inputs.

Trained and evaluated a linear regression
            model using an 80/20 split.
takeaways:
The linear regression model achieved
            an R² of 0.77.

Residual analysis showed greater error
            variation for higher-priced homes.

The project helped me practice data
            preparation, model evaluation, and
            communicating results.
tools:
Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib,
          Seaborn, Scikit-learn

title: Sex Differences in Obesity Predictors
description:
A health data analysis exploring BMI,
          calorie expenditure, and activity
          patterns across sex groups.
background:
This project examines how health and
          activity measures relate to BMI, and
          whether those relationships differ
          across the groups represented in
          the dataset.
methods: Cleaned and organized health and activity data.

Performed exploratory analysis using
            Pandas and Seaborn.

Compared BMI, calorie expenditure,
            and activity measures by sex.

Created visualizations to explore
            patterns in the data.
takeaways:
How do BMI and calorie expenditure
            vary across sex groups?

How strongly are workout calories
            associated with BMI?

Which other measures might help
            explain differences in BMI?
tools:
Python, Pandas, Seaborn,
          Data Visualization,
          Exploratory Data Analysis

title: Friends TV Show Dialogue & Sentiment Analysis
description:
A project exploring character dialogue
          and emotional patterns in the television
          series Friends .
background:
Dialogue data offers a way to explore
          how characters contribute to a story.
          This project uses the show's transcripts
          to examine character representation
          and sentiment patterns.
methods:
Created visualizations using Pandas
            and Seaborn.
takeaways:
How is dialogue distributed across
            the main characters?

How do sentiment patterns change
            across episodes?

What can dialogue frequency tell us
            about character representation?
tools:
Python, Pandas, Seaborn,
          Text Analysis, Sentiment Analysis,
          Data Visualization
